sentences.en: The mice were afraid of the house cat.

sentences.ar: עכבר צעיר אמר: נשים עליו פעמון.
sentences.en: A young mouse said: we will put a bell on him.
They were all delighted and said yes.

sentences.ar: עכבר זקן שאל: מי ישים אותו.
sentences.en: An old mouse asked: who will put it on.
It is easy to suggest and hard to do.
